events.title: Masc, Mask & Masked is taking part in October's Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello!!! 🐙👋 We’re excited to announce that Masc, Mask & Masked is part of Steam Next Fest! The demo is available for the whole festival, so now’s the perfect time to give it a try. Playing one route is about 20min of cosmic comedy, but if you want to get to the end of the demo and unravel it's secret, it can be 1h of gameplay full of twinks, bears, dolls and tentacles. 💌🐙✨ Mini demo update 🔧We’ve also made a few minor fixes to the demo. events.title: Masc, Mask & Masked is going to be at the San Diego Comic-Con Málaga! 🥳🥸
events.summary: Hello, guys! We are thrilled to announce that we are debuting our demo at an in-person event. The event is none other than the San Diego Comic-Con Málaga! 🥳🥸 We are going to show the demo for the first time! We will bring stickers, prints , and maybe some more cool things with us. If you want to try the game or say hi to the devs, please stop by our booth! Also, make sure to follow us on our socials to stay tuned to this adventure and more: https://linktr.ee/mascmaskmasked See you there! 🦑
